messages.subject: error in gl.plot.structure - bug?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I get an error message while using the gl.plot.structure function and am not sure why. I used gl.run.structure first to do the STRUCTURE analysis and saved this as out_struc4. The gl.evanno(out_struc4) function works as well showing me 4 plots. However, when use gl.plot.structure as below it gives be the following error message:

> qmat4 <- gl.plot.structure(out_struc4, K=2)

Starting gl.plot.structure

Error in mcl(simMatrix, addLoops = TRUE)$Cluster :

  $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors


Code I used
out_struc4 <- gl.run.structure(
gl5,
k.range = 1:5,
num.k.rep = 10,
burnin = 30000, # 30,000
numreps = 1000000, # 1,000,000
exec = "C:/Installers/structure_windows_console/console/structure.exe",
noadmix=FALSE)

out_evanno4 <- gl.evanno(out_struc4)
qmat4 <- gl.plot.structure(out_struc4, K=2, colors_clusters = c("#1F78B4", "#33A02C"))

I have used the exact same code before with different parameter values for burnin and numreps and it worked perfectly. Would anyone know why suddenly this code isn’t working anymore and how I could potentially fix this? The code ran for ~60 hours but now I can’t access the results. It does show up in my working environment in R as a list of 50 so I’m not sure what is going wrong.

Additionally, it says the output file is in a certain directory: gtypes.created.on.2023-06-27.12.00.42.structureRun/gtypes.created.on.2023-06-27.12.00.42.structureRun.k5.r10_out_f. But this directory is not found on my computer.

Any help or suggestions would be much appreciated!


Thank you,
Chiara
